1.body:
Hello,

I saw your opening for a Graphics Designer at TNM Furnitech and would love to bring my background in digital and print branding to your team in Nagpur.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have designed over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable templates that reduced turnaround time. I also bring strong proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, and CorelDraw.

My branding kit project for an early-stage startup demonstrates my ability to build visual identity systems from the ground up, which you can see in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I live in Nagpur and am available to start immediately. Could we schedule a brief call this week to discuss how I can support your visual identity?

Ananya

2.body:
Hi Peter,

I saw your Junior Product Designer opening, and I am drawn to the opportunity to shape onboarding flows and dashboards for your global workforce platform.

In my current role at Ascent Business Solutions, I work with stakeholders to build reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time across 100+ digital and print creatives. Previously at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, which you can view in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Based in Nagpur, I am comfortable working asynchronously and would welcome a brief look at my B2B design process.

Ananya
